title: Certified Verification of Alpha-Beta Pruning via Monadic Continuations
abstract: We construct a standalone zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 formalization of 18 core monadic alpha-beta pruning theorems—including full mutually recursive inductive proofs of Lemma 2, Theorem 1, Corollaries 1(a)-(b) and 2, Reader and Continuation monad laws, tie-preserving pickMax/pickMin, and the exact Wikipedia 36-leaf tree (zero sorry, zero warnings, zero Classical.choice)—for Martin Hotzel Escardo and Paulo Oliva (arXiv:2611.32320, Nov 2026), paired with a zero-floating-point exact discrete four-mode certificate verifier (ALPHABETA-MONAD-CERT-1.0). Across 16 canonical certificates (0.092-103.002 ms, total 124.66 ms), all exact leaf-evaluation traces, aspiration-window regimes, Definition 2 optimal-play witnesses, and full history-dependent Tic-Tac-Toe pruning (9! = 362,880 to 9,335 plays, 38.873x speedup) replay deterministically while rejecting 60/60 live adversarial forgery attacks.
ai_assistance_disclosure: Prepared by sole author Lluis Eriksson with AI coding, formalization, and drafting assistance from Google Antigravity; all Lean 4 proofs, exact discrete certificates, and adversarial tests were independently compiled and machine-verified locally.
